payload.note: Gauss-Newton Witten checkpoint: the raw pointwise full-residual field v_G=lambda^2*(Dr^T Dr)^(-1)dT and the centered flat-map analogue are both obstructed as exact or scalar-renormalizable Witten inverses. Exact rational C4 jets give L1 v_G=(49/50)dT at the vacuum for the full candidate and (9/10)dT for the centered candidate. At Omega=(1,1,2,2), both defects have nonzero lowest-sine and checkerboard components, so a scalar repair is impossible. The exact remainder is the configuration-space L0 derivative plus the residual-weighted embedding-curvature term; the full and centered metrics additionally differ by the mean-residual rank-one term. This is a method obstruction only. Connection-corrected/nonlocal Witten coercivity, a low-Rayleigh sequence, the normalized lowest-mode and interacting H^-1 bounds, continuum reconstruction, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian claims remain open.
